comments:
Hi @mschappa! We appreciate you submitting your first issue for our open-source project. 🌟

Even though I'm a bot, I can assure you that the whole community is genuinely grateful for your time and effort. 🤖💙
Thanks for the report. Could you send a pr as you have a fix proposal?

review_comments:
@mschappa, thanks, the change looks fine to me.

I'm trying to figure out why DevB is not forwarding the announce message properly at the moment. Shouldn't master_priority.root_system_id already be same as gm_prio->root_system_id at this point? 
Or is it getting stuck in the GPTP_INFO_IS_MINE case?

Would you mind uploading a wireshark capture before and after the change, please?

Hi @talih0, thanks for taking a look. At the moment I do not have access to the board but I can do a capture during next week probably. While debugging, for me it looked like it is always considering GPTP_INFO_IS_MINE case before sending announce messages and therefore, the information always contained the configured values instead the once received from the GM.

@jukkar @talih0 sorry for the delay. I was out of office until today.

Please find attached two wireshark logs _announce_before_fix.pcap_ and _announce_after_fix.pcap_ within [announce_pcaps.zip](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/files/13888173/announce_pcaps.zip). Both have been captured at DEV-C according to the issue description #66646:
 - Dev-C is identified as LCFCHeFe_7c:a9:ac
 - Dev-B is identified as RenesasE_00:00:01

When looking a the announce messages before the fix, we can see that DEV-B forwards its own priority1 as 200. After the fix it forwards the GM prioity1 as 100.
